# staticform_submissions (Data Source)

Read the (non-spam) submissions of a form. Read-only.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `form_id` (String) Form ID to read submissions from.

### Read-Only

- `submissions` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--submissions))

<a id="nestedatt--submissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `submissions`

- `data` (Map of String) Submitted field values.
